features.name: url_structural_risk_score
features.description: Weighted sum of URL-level structural risk indicators (negated so higher means more suspicious). Captures lexical/URL anatomy signals useful for a linear margin.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth additive composite of URL anomalies that aligns with linear SVM margin direction.
features.formula: (-1.0) * (having_IP_Address + URL_Length + Shortining_Service + having_At_Symbol + double_slash_redirecting + Prefix_Suffix + having_Sub_Domain)

features.name: ssl_domain_trust_score
features.description: Composite trust score from SSL state, domain registration length, favicon legitimacy, port usage, HTTPS token, and DNS record presence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous trust composite for linear projection.
features.formula: SSLfinal_State + Domain_registeration_length + Favicon + port + HTTPS_token + DNSRecord

features.name: content_integrity_score
features.description: Composite of page-content integrity signals: request URL, anchors, link tags, SFH, submitting to email, and abnormal URL.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear composite of in-page integrity cues benefits SVM hyperplane separation.
features.formula: Request_URL + URL_of_Anchor + Links_in_tags + SFH + Submitting_to_email + Abnormal_URL

features.name: behavioral_obfuscation_score
features.description: Composite of dynamic/behavioral obfuscation indicators: redirect, on_mouseover, right click disabled, popup window, iframe.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates browser-behavior risk signals into a single smooth axis for linear margin.

features.name: reputation_score
features.description: External reputation composite: domain age, web traffic, page rank, Google indexing, inbound links, statistical report.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reputation axis is a strong linear discriminator for legitimacy assessment.
features.formula: age_of_domain + web_traffic + Page_Rank + Google_Index + Links_pointing_to_page + Statistical_report

features.name: global_risk_composite
features.description: Normalized average of all 30 indicator columns, scaled to [-1,1]. Acts as a global linear score across all features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single normalized summary axis ideal for linear SVM bias direction.
features.formula: (having_IP_Address + URL_Length + Shortining_Service + having_At_Symbol + double_slash_redirecting + Prefix_Suffix + having_Sub_Domain + SSLfinal_State + Domain_registeration_length + Favicon + port + HTTPS_token + Request_URL + URL_of_Anchor + Links_in_tags + SFH + Submitting_to_email + Abnormal_URL + Redirect + on_mouseover + RightClick + popUpWidnow + Iframe + age_of_domain + DNSRecord + web_traffic + Page_Rank + Google_Index + Links_pointing_to_page + Statistical_report) / 30.0

features.name: negative_indicator_density
features.description: Fraction of indicator columns taking the value -1 (suspicious). Smooth severity measure in [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Density-based severity scales linearly with risk and supports SVM margins.
features.formula: (np.where(having_IP_Address == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(URL_Length == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Shortining_Service == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(having_At_Symbol == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(double_slash_redirecting == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Prefix_Suffix == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(having_Sub_Domain == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(SSLfinal_State == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Domain_registeration_length == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Favicon == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(port == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(HTTPS_token == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Request_URL == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(URL_of_Anchor == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Links_in_tags == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(SFH == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Submitting_to_email == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Abnormal_URL == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(on_mouseover == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(RightClick == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(popUpWidnow == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Iframe == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(age_of_domain == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(DNSRecord == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(web_traffic == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Page_Rank == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Google_Index == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Links_pointing_to_page == -1, 1, 0) + np.where(Statistical_report == -1, 1, 0)) / 29.0

features.name: positive_indicator_density
features.description: Fraction of indicator columns taking value +1 (legitimate signal). Smooth measure in [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Counter-axis to negative density; supports linear separability.
features.formula: (np.where(having_IP_Address == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(URL_Length == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Shortining_Service == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(having_At_Symbol == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(double_slash_redirecting == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Prefix_Suffix == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(having_Sub_Domain == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(SSLfinal_State == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Domain_registeration_length == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Favicon == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(port == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(HTTPS_token == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Request_URL == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(URL_of_Anchor == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Links_in_tags == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(SFH == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Submitting_to_email == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Abnormal_URL == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(on_mouseover == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(RightClick == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(popUpWidnow == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Iframe == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(age_of_domain == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(DNSRecord == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(web_traffic == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Page_Rank == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Google_Index == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Links_pointing_to_page == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Statistical_report == 1, 1, 0)) / 29.0

features.name: ssl_anchor_interaction
features.description: Interaction between SSL final state and URL-of-anchor quality, capturing combined trust evidence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Pairwise product creates a useful non-collinear axis for linear SVM.

features.name: domain_reputation_ratio
features.description: Smooth ratio of positive reputation evidence over total reputation evidence magnitude (with smoothing).
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded smooth ratio improves SVM stability versus raw sums.
features.formula: (np.where(age_of_domain == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(web_traffic == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Page_Rank == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(Google_Index == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(DNSRecord == 1, 1, 0) + 1.0) / (np.abs(age_of_domain) + np.abs(web_traffic) + np.abs(Page_Rank) + np.abs(Google_Index) + np.abs(DNSRecord) + 2.0)

features.name: url_anomaly_severity
features.description: Semantic severity assessment of URL-level deceptiveness combining IP-in-URL, length anomalies, shortening, @ symbol, double-slash redirect, and prefix/suffix usage. Computed as a normalized count of how many URL anomalies are present in the suspicious state, scaled to [0,1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures human-judgment notion of URL deceptiveness as a smooth severity score that supports a linear margin.

features.name: user_interaction_suspicion
features.description: Semantic judgment of suspicious user-interaction tampering: disabled right-click, mouseover changes, popups, iframes, and redirects. Higher values indicate more behavioral red flags.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compact behavioral suspicion axis aligned to linear separation boundaries.
